events.evidence: Ukrainian forces strike the strategic Antonivka Road Bridge in Kherson Oblast using its M142 HIMARS missile system
European Union energy ministers approve legislation to lower demand for gas by some member countries by 15% from August until March 2023
Ukraine says that Russia has launched cruise missile strikes at targets along its Black Sea coast, including at Odesa and Mykolaiv port infrastructure

label.note: Ukraine strikes Kherson bridge and Russia hits ports; EU approves 15% gas demand cut, raising energy and geopolitical risk.
